facebook.caption:
This place fixes something you didn't know was broken.

Dinh Cậu sits at the edge of Phu Quoc, a small shrine to the sea goddess, striped lighthouse behind it, fishing boats below. No queue. No entrance fee. Just harbor wind and the smell of incense.

Locals come here at sunrise. Tourists arrive at sunset. Both are right.

4.5 stars across 3,903 reviews. Go see why.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walk to the tip of the rock. Incense smoke, lighthouse stripes, boats coming in. Dinh Cậu at golden hour hits differently. 4.5 stars. 3,903 people agree.
